en.name: Jamón serrano, whole leg
en.summary: A whole jamón serrano is shelf-stable by design: the official IGP specification sets a minimum cure of two hundred and ten days from salting with at least a third of the weight lost, and states that once curing is finished the ham may remain at room temperature. Kept in a cool, dry, airy room it runs 6–12 months. Do not refrigerate the leg.
en.pantry: Hang it or stand it on its rack in a cool, dry, ventilated room at about 15–20 °C, out of direct sun, and never in a sealed bag. A whole leg keeps 6–12 months there. The stability comes from the cure and the water loss, not from cold — those duration figures are borrowed from the equivalent American country ham and from ordinary Spanish practice, so treat them as quality guidance rather than a published limit. Once you cut into it, cover the exposed face with its own fat and a cloth, keep working across the same face, and finish a started leg within a few weeks to a couple of months before the cut face dries out and turns rancid.
en.fridge: Do not refrigerate a whole leg — there is no fridge timeline here on purpose. Cold hardens the fat, flattens the aroma, and brings condensation and surface mould as soon as you take the leg out again. A cool larder, a cellar or simply the coolest room in the house is the right place. If you live somewhere hot and humid and genuinely cannot keep a leg cool, buy it sliced instead and store the packs cold.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for a whole leg and freezing one makes no sense in any case: a leg is too big, it is already stable at room temperature, and the fat that carries all the flavour is what a freezer damages. The only thing worth freezing is trim and bones, for stock or for a pot of beans.
spoilage: A rancid, old-oil smell from the cut face, especially on a leg left half-finished.
A sour or ammonia smell near the hip bone when you probe it.
Fuzzy green, grey or black mould as distinct from the normal dry white bloom.
Slime or a sticky wetness anywhere on the surface, usually a sign of a damp room.
tips: Buy the leg only if you can give it a cool, dry room and will finish it in reasonable time.
Cover the cut face with its own trimmed fat after every session.
Work across one face rather than opening several; each new face starts drying immediately.
Keep the bones and trim for stock — freeze those separately.

faq.q: Does a whole jamón serrano need refrigerating?
faq.a: No. The specification for the cured product allows it to stay at room temperature, and cold damages both fat and aroma. Keep it in a cool, dry, airy room.

faq.q: How long does a whole leg of serrano keep?
faq.a: 6–12 months in a cool, dry room while it is uncut. Once started, aim to finish it within a few weeks to a couple of months.

faq.q: What do you do with the cut face between sessions?
faq.a: Cover it with its own trimmed fat and a cloth, and keep cutting across the same face rather than opening a new one.

faq.q: Can you freeze a whole jamón?
faq.a: No timeline exists for it and there is no reason to. It is already stable at room temperature, and freezing damages the fat.

zh.name: 西班牙生火腿整腿
zh.summary: 整支塞拉諾火腿本來就是常溫穩定的設計：官方 IGP 規範要求從抹鹽起至少熟成兩百一十天、失重至少三分之一，並明白寫著熟成程序完成後火腿可以留在常溫。放在陰涼、乾燥、通風的房間可放 6～12 個月。整支腿不要冰。
zh.pantry: 把它吊起來或架在腿架上，放在大約 15～20 °C、陰涼乾燥通風、不曬太陽的房間，絕對不要裝進密封袋。整支腿在那裡可以放 6～12 個月。它的穩定來自熟成與失水，不是來自低溫——這些天數是借自美國 country ham 與西班牙的日常做法，請當成品質指引而非官方上限。一旦開刀，就用它自己的油脂加一塊布蓋住切面，固定在同一個面上作業，並在幾週到兩個月內把這支腿吃完，免得切面變乾走油耗。
zh.fridge: 整支腿不要冷藏——這裡刻意沒有冷藏期限。低溫會讓油脂變硬、香氣變平，而且一拿出來就結露、長表面霉。陰涼的儲藏室、地下室，或家裡最涼的房間，才是正確的位置。如果你住在濕熱的地方、實在無法給它一個涼爽環境，那就改買切片，並把包裝冷藏。
zh.freezer: 整支腿沒有冷凍期限，冷凍它本身也沒道理：體積太大、它本來就能常溫穩定，而承載所有風味的油脂正是冷凍庫會傷害的東西。唯一值得冷凍的是修下來的邊肉和骨頭，留著熬湯或煮豆子。
spoilage: 切面散發油耗、陳油味，尤其是切到一半擱置很久的腿。
用探針試髖骨附近時聞到酸味或氨味。
長出綠、灰、黑色的絨毛霉（正常的是乾燥的白色粉狀霉花）。
表面任何地方發黏或濕黏，通常代表房間太潮濕。
tips: 先確定家裡有陰涼乾燥的空間、也吃得完，再買整支腿。
每次切完都用修下來的油脂蓋住切面。
固定切同一個面，不要同時開好幾個面；每開一個新面就多一個立刻開始變乾的表面。
骨頭和邊肉留著熬湯，另外分開冷凍。

faq.q: 整支西班牙生火腿需要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 不需要。熟成完成的產品規範允許它留在常溫，而低溫會傷害油脂與香氣。請放陰涼乾燥通風的房間。

faq.q: 整支生火腿可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開刀時，在陰涼乾燥的房間可放 6～12 個月。開刀之後請在幾週到兩個月內吃完。

faq.q: 兩次切之間，切面要怎麼處理？
faq.a: 用它自己修下來的油脂加一塊布蓋住，並且固定切同一個面，不要另外開新面。

faq.q: 整支生火腿可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 沒有對應期限，也沒有理由這麼做。它本來就常溫穩定，冷凍只會傷害油脂。
